text:
QUOTE: "stated scope (tool-call argument) ──► if present and usable, use it ... .clew.yaml index_scope: ──► if present and usable, use it (present but unusable → rejected) ... whole repository (less ignores) ──► the default"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says a declared scope is preferred and that nothing declared falls to the whole repo. But it says a rejected declaration is "rejected", and it flags as unverified whether `derive_scope` falls through or the CLI refuses. So it does not state that every failure to find a declared scope falls through to the whole repository.
